name: evo_propose
description: Crystallize a newly discovered bug-prevention Rule, reusable multi-step Skill (SOP), parameterized Micro-Tool script, or AST-anchored Episodic Memory (fault case) into .evo/. Enforces deterministic Gatekeeper checks: Static Security, Sandbox/AST Grounding, BM25 Deduplication, and 1,500-token Core Rule Budget.

confidence.description: Causal attribution confidence; confounded blocks rule/skill elevation.

content.description: [For rule] Actionable markdown guardrails and rationale (code-state SSOT decoupled; use "Case Anchor:" for concrete symbol/threshold examples).

contrastive_evidence.description: Before-vs-after execution contrast proving causal isolation.

core.description: [For rule] Whether this rule belongs in the always-on 1,500-token core invariants digest.

hook_trigger.description: Optional declarative pre-tool/post-tool guard trigger for micro-tools.

input_schema.description: [For tool] JSON Schema describing accepted arguments.

l0_summary.description: Plain-spoken 1-sentence human takeaway ("Scenario -> Root Cause -> Fix / Guardrail", <= 35 words / <= 140 chars) for fast human & agent scanning.

l1_contract.description: [For skill] Trigger conditions, required inputs, and expected outputs.

root_cause.description: [For memory] Underlying root cause analysis explaining why the symptom occurred.

script_code.description: [For tool] Full script source code. Must exit 0 when invoked with --self-test or EVO_SELF_TEST=1.

self_test_args.description: [For tool] Sample arguments passed during Gatekeeper sandbox dry-run.

solution.description: [For memory] Verified fix summary and verification steps.

supersedes_id.description: Optional ID of an older capability that this proposal upgrades/replaces.

symptom.description: [For memory] Observed error message, fault symptom, or anomalous packet/log signature.

tags.description: [For skill / tool / memory] Searchable domain tags.

target_symbols.description: [For memory] Core code symbols or file#symbol targets (e.g., ["src/core/telemetry.ts#search", "BmsCanRxHandler"]) for automatic AST structural fingerprinting.

title.description: Short, plain-spoken human title (avoid opaque academic jargon; clearly state the scenario or fix).

transfer_scenarios.description: [For rule] At least 2 distinct cross-module/cross-scenario applications proving 1-level-up transferability.

trigger_cue.description: Optional situation trigger cue (<=120 chars) for skills.

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to the active project workspace. Routes EvoKernel to the nearest .evo/ directory at or above this path instead of the MCP server process cwd.
